name: Pan Gallery
description: Oversized scattered tile board that pans smoothly with the pointer or touch; colored tiles reveal their photo on hover and scale up slightly.
contents: Full-screen dark board with scattered colored tiles, each holding an image
behavior: Board is larger than the viewport and pans opposite to pointer position with a slow eased animation
Hovering a tile fades in its image and scales the tile
On touch devices the board pans with finger movement and images are always visible
editableByProps: Tile images, alt text, colors, sizes and positions
Board size, pan speed and background color

needsCodeEdit.change: Change tile hover scale or reveal timing
needsCodeEdit.where: className of the tile div inside tiles.map

fixed: Fills the full viewport width and height (w-screen h-screen) and hides overflow
